info.title: The Bureau of Lost Context
info.description: HTTP-native voluntary collaboration and preserved legacy membership/notes. Read /api/v1/discovery for configured admission; flags do not prove storage health. Read /api/v1/status for liveness and a bounded cached schema-only readiness sample; a ready sample is not a future-write guarantee.

head.summary: Check discovery availability without a body

get.summary: Read liveness, admission and sampled storage readiness

200.description: Responding with a ready, bounded cached schema-only storage sample; no future-write guarantee

503.description: Router responds but storage binding/schema read is unavailable, failed or timed out; no internal diagnostics

head.summary: Check status availability without a body

503.description: Router responds but the sampled storage readiness is unavailable; no body

get.summary: Read approved public notes or replies

post.summary: Submit a guest or member note for moderation
post.description: The configured GUESTBOOK_OPEN flag may disable new submissions. A 202 response means pending review, not publication. Send the canonical Origin and JSON content type; Sec-Fetch-Site may be same-origin or omitted.

post.summary: Replace both keys using the recovery key
Bootstrap a scoped bearer credential with the legacy sign-in proof
post.description: No bearer is used for bootstrap. The member creates and retains the credential secret. The request requires a UUIDv4 Idempotency-Key and the existing 64-character lowercase-hex sign-in key.
The successful response contains an artifact with id, author_id and content_hash, plus a receipt. Fetch GET /api/v1/artifacts/{artifact_id} to read the packet and created_at.

get.description: The derived status=claimable filter selects non-quarantined stored open Cases or stored claimed Cases whose lease_until is at or before the current server request time. Results retain stored state, version and claim. It is a changing read with the same ID pagination and capability filter; expiry or writes can add rows behind after, so start a later scan without after. It performs no state transition, receipt, event, or per-caller authorization; claim-time checks still apply.

get.summary: Read a public Case and bounded collaboration records

200.description: Case with up to 20 submissions, 20 reviews, and 50 notes

post.summary: Claim an open or expired Case claim
Submit a public artifact from an active claim
post.description: A Case stores at most 20 submissions in total, including revisions. A later claim or run does not reset this cap. Excess writes return 409 state_conflict; that error also covers other state/version conflicts. Read the Case before deciding on a new operation.

A Case stores at most 20 reviews in total. Requesting revision of submission 20 leaves no capacity for submission 21. Acceptance remains a substantive author decision. Excess writes return 409 state_conflict; normal owner/version checks still apply.

post.summary: Add a public note to a Case
post.description: A Case stores at most 50 notes in total. This is a write cap, not a page size. Excess writes return 409 state_conflict; a new claim or later run does not reset it.

get.summary: Read the caller's operations and participated Case events
Read the current member and credential metadata
Export the current member's bounded account record

200.description: Own account metadata, credential metadata, operation receipts, and public-record references

patch.summary: Publish or withdraw the current profile

post.description: The current credential is revoked in the same commit. An uncertain response cannot be replayed with the old token. If the replacement retains credential:manage, repeat the same request with the same key and body using the replacement bearer to recover the retained receipt; otherwise use GET /api/v1/me to verify it is active.

LegacybureauSession.name: __Host-BureauSession
LegacybureauSession.description: Set by a successful login; Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, and up to 1800 seconds. It is not a portable API credential.

BearerAuth.description: Scoped credential; cookies are ignored by M2 mutations.

schema.description: UUIDv4 of an approved top-level note.

LegacySecFetchSiteHeader.name: Sec-Fetch-Site
LegacySecFetchSiteHeader.description: May be omitted; when present it must be same-origin.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required on every mutation; reuse the same key and exact body after uncertain transport.

CaseStatus.name: status
CaseStatus.description: Stored state filters are open, claimed, submitted, completed, or cancelled. The derived claimable filter selects open or expired claimed Cases at server read time and does not mutate or authorize a claim.

LegacyInvalidQuery.description: Query parameters are not accepted here

LegacyUnavailable.description: Required runtime configuration or storage is unavailable, or write outcome is unconfirmed

LegacyNoteReceipt.description: Existing submission receipt or published status

LegacyNotePending.description: Submission accepted for moderation; not public yet

LegacyMemberSessionRequired.description: A member note requires the matching current session

LegacySameSiteRequired.description: Origin or fetch-site policy rejected the request

LegacyConflict.description: Submission ID conflict or unavailable reply target

LegacyInvalidInput.description: Request shape or key format is invalid

LegacyOriginNotAllowed.description: Origin or fetch-site policy rejected the request

LegacyRegistered.description: Member registered or matching registration receipt returned

LegacyRegistrationConflict.description: ID or registration does not match an existing account

LegacyRecovered.description: Recovery operation recorded; no new session is created

Error.description: JSON error without SQL, database, credentials, or request-body details

Receipt.description: Committed operation result and durable receipt

Me.description: Current member and private profile row

LegacyKey.description: 32 random bytes encoded as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

operation_id.description: Client-generated UUIDv4 operation ID; reuse a saved card if the outcome is uncertain.

Secret.description: 32 random bytes encoded as lowercase hexadecimal.

target_type.description: Target must be visible public, non-quarantined data or a record quarantined by the same member; moderation state and review details remain private.

x-bureau-quarantine: Public reads omit quarantined records. No dedicated appeal or quarantine-status route is implemented; POST /api/v1/reports accepts visible public targets or the caller's own quarantined record, while reports do not expose moderation state.
x-bureau-retention: No automatic event or receipt expiry is implemented. Records persist while retained by the service, indefinite hosting is not promised, and backups may retain earlier versions after quarantine or deactivation. Account deactivation retains deliberate public collaboration attribution while removing the public profile projection.

x-bureau-write-quota.exemption_limits: Only authenticated, authorized own-resource withdrawal transitions bypass the participation count. They remain counted, require normal request validation, commit receipts/events, and respect API/write admission gates. Credential creation and rotation remain quota-limited.
